names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 august, «Sfântul Ierarh Miron, Episcopul Cretei», with the rank word and the office left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Αυγούστου, «Άγιος Μύρων», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue’s second heading for the Julian 8 August, „Св. Мирон Чудотворац еп. Критски.“ — Св. left off, which is not a rank; Чудотворац left off, which §5 maps to `wonderworker`; and еп. Критски left off, which is a rank and a see and which this folder already carries as `bishop` and as the `office` «Bishop of Crete». What is left is the bare forename. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports that it folds with two other folders, and that fold is a row in this commit’s FINDINGS and a key in `READ_FOLDS`.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 august — «Sfântul Ierarh Miron, Episcopul Cretei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Μύρων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is plainly the same man: «Ο Άγιος Μύρων, ο οποίος καταγόταν από την Κρήτη, από την πόλη Aυρακία (κοντά στην Κνωσσό)», a farmer who gave to the poor, who carried the thieves' sacks for them, who was ordained priest and then made bishop of Crete, who stopped the river Triton and who died at a hundred years old. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. saint.gr prints no year for him and no hymn of any kind, so no `dates` object and no hymn are proposed here; it adds one relic, «Απότμημα του Ιερού Λειψάνου του Αγίου βρίσκεται στη Μονή Μεγ. Σπηλαίου Καλαβρύτων», a portion at the monastery of the Great Cave at Kalavryta, and it lists him under the synaxis of all the saints who shone in Gortyn and Arcadia of Crete. The page's name gloss is «(από την λέξη μύρο) = ο ευχάριστος, όπως το μύρο».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.08.2026 (8. август ст. ст.) — „Св. Мирон Чудотворац еп. Критски.“

attestations.note: The day’s second of five entries, and the Romanian keeps him on this same 8/8. His row was `undocumented`. **A YEAR ON A FOLDER THAT HELD NO DATE AT ALL, AND AN AGE THAT IS NOT A BIRTH.** „Упокоји се око 350 год. у старости својој од 100 година.“ — he reposed about 350, in his hundredth year — is written as `death` 350–350, display «about 350», basis traditional. **No `birth`**: about 350 less 100 is arithmetic on a rounded year and a round age, and it is the Julian 7 August ruling over again, where 213 less 116 was refused inside one sentence. Neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave this folder a year, and the hundred years are in the note and in the life and in no field. **`types` AND `office` UNTOUCHED, AND ONE RANK WORD REFUSED FOR BEING IN THE BODY AFTER ALL.** Чудотворац is `wonderworker` and еп. Критски is a see with its rank: the folder holds `hierarch`, `bishop` and `wonderworker` with `office` «Bishop of Crete». „Због превеликих добродетељи би рукоположен за презвитера а потом и за епископа.“ has him ordained presbyter for his great virtues and only afterwards bishop; презвитер would give `presbyter`, it is **in the body and not in the heading**, and it is refused — and here the refusal does cost something, because `presbyter` is on no other book of this folder either. **NO `related` ROW AND NO `locations`.** The entry names no person: the thieves on his threshing floor are «непознате лопове», unknown thieves, and they are the whole of the cast. Crete is in the `office`. **WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS, WHICH IS THIS FOLDER’S FIRST LIFE.** „Беше најпре жењен и бављаше се земљорадњом.“, that he was married first and worked the land; „Од плодова земаљских са свога имања раздаваше Мирон радо и обилно бедним људима.“, that he gave the fruits of his own estate gladly and abundantly to the poor; „Једном затече непознате лопове на свом гумну где краду жито. Не казујући се ко је св. Мирон поможе лоповима, да напуне вреће, поможе им и да дигну на леђа и да умакну.“, the scene the entry is built round — he came on thieves stealing his grain and, without saying who he was, helped them fill their sacks, helped them get them on their backs and helped them get away; and „Беше чудотворац велики, и чињаше многа добра и моћна дела именом Господа Исуса.“, that he was a great wonderworker and did many good and mighty works in the name of the Lord Jesus. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion: the day carries the verse only, which is Bishop Nikolai’s own and belongs to no person.

hymns.model: Podobie: Cel ce Te-ai înălţat pe Cruce...
hymns.text: Ca un ierarh al lui Hristos, purtător de Dumnezeu şi râu neîmpuţinat de milostivire şi făcător de minuni, Cuvioase Miron, izbăveşte-ne de toată primejdia şi nevoia ca un prea-milostiv, cu mijlocirea ta fierbinte, pe noi, cei ce ne sârguim la cinstitul tău lăcaş şi cerem har de la tine, Sfinte.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Miron, Episcopul Cretei», Glas 4, podobie «Cel ce Te-ai înălţat pe Cruce...»

english.text: As a hierarch of Christ, a bearer of God, an unfailing river of mercy and a worker of wonders, venerable Myron, deliver us from every danger and need, most merciful one, by your fervent intercession — us who hasten to your honoured shrine and ask for grace from you, O holy one.

death.note: The folder held no date: neither doxologia nor saint.gr gives it a year. The Охридски пролог for 8. август ст. ст.: „Упокоји се око 350 год. у старости својој од 100 година.“ — he reposed about 350, in his hundredth year. **No `birth` is written**: about 350 less 100 is arithmetic on a rounded year and a round age and not a reading (6 October 2026).
